usedFor: Timesheet holds teams, projects and tasks, and Calendly makes a booking link with “Create Scheduling Link” after “New Project”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Project” in Timesheet, then “Create Scheduling Link” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: A new project often starts with a kickoff, and the action makes the link to book it.

watchOut: “New Project” is polling, so the link arrives after a scheduled check.
